title.narrative: Core Support to Georgian Farmers' Association Phase II
Core Support to Georgian Farmers' Association Phase II

description.narrative:
Den föreslagna insatsen är ett kärnstöd till Georgian Farmers' Association (GFA) för genomförandet av dess nya femåriga strategiplan (2025-2029). GFA är en nationell organisation som grundades 2012. Det är en paraplyorganisation som i vilken många jordbruksföreningar,enskilda medlemmar och jordbruksföretag ingår.
Ambassaden har gett kärnstöd för genomförandet av GFA:s strategi 2020-2024. Under det sista året av genomförandet beställdes en extern utvärdering av ambassaden. Utvärderingen rekommenderar starkt ambassaden att fortsätta sitt finansiella stöd till GFA. Enligt utvärderingen har GFA varit framgångsrikt i att uppnå resultat och har överlag god kapacitet.

The proposed action is a core support to the Georgian Farmers' Association (GFA) for the implementation of its new five-year strategic plan (2025-2029). The GFA is a national organisation established in 2012. It is an umbrella organisation that includes many farmers' associations, individual members and farms.
The Embassy has been providing core support for the implementation of the GFA Strategy 2020-2024. In the last year of implementation, an external evaluation was commissioned by the Embassy. The evaluation strongly recommends the Embassy to continue its financial support to the GFA. According to the evaluation, the GFA has been successful in achieving results and has overall good capacity.

GFA's mission is to strenghten the climate-friendly agricultural sector in Georgia and improve the quality of life of Georgian farmers together and promoting their visibility.
GFA's vision is to sustainably increase agricultural productivity in Georgia, strengthen the competitiveness of farmers and ensure that their contribution to the economic, social and environmental development of Georgia is recognized.
GFA's goals are:
To be the main advocacy body for Georgian farmers.
To provide programmes and services to farmers that will strengthen their economic and social position in the Georgian society.
To build and sustain a strong local and global network forming strategic partnerships for Georgian farmers.
